description_en: Lists the data addresses created by a user in the specific region
description_zh: 列举用户在该区域下的数据地址
name: ListAddress

parameters.help_en:
The marker after which the migration addresses are listed.
By default, this parameter is left empty
parameters.help_zh:
设定从该marker之后列举迁移地址。  
默认值：无
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the number of migration addresses to be returned.
Valid values: 0 - 1000 (excluding 0).
Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回迁移地址的数量。  
取值：大于0小于等于1000  
默认值：1000
parameters.name: count
